name: usdinr
notes: FBIL reference rate via the site's own JSON API (wasdm/refrates/fetchfiltered, one request per calendar year, authenticated=false). displayTime is the source-stated publication instant (IST); clock_quality published.
Unauthenticated FBIL access lags: last available date 2026-10-16, build date 2026-10-23. Days after the last date are absent, not filled.

DEXINUS (FRED, latest vintage, observation_start 2021-01-01) joined on civil date as a cross-check only; 750 days differ by more than 0.05 (listed under diff_over_threshold_days). Different fixings: Mumbai 13:00/13:30 IST vs New York noon.
Business-day gaps: 111 weekdays without an FBIL rate between the first and last date; 110 explained by the captured RBI Mumbai holiday matrix, 1 unexplained (see gaps).
Rows are deduplicated on date (first occurrence kept); no synthetic rows.
